---
name: Design proposal / 设计提案
about: Propose a bounded design change / 提出范围明确的设计改动
---

# Design proposal / 设计提案

## Problem and phase / 问题与阶段

Describe the user/developer problem and the phase that needs it. / 说明用户或开发问题及所属阶段。

## Proposal and alternatives / 方案与备选

Explain flow, ownership, lifetime, limits and alternatives. / 说明流程、所有权、生命周期、限制和备选。

## Verification and cost / 验证与成本

State evidence, experiments, resource/dependency cost and failure behavior. Label unverified claims.
说明依据、实验、资源/依赖成本和失败行为，标记未验证结论。
